body:
Founder real-time, direct follow-up to S476: 'we need the ability to turn it on and off visually in the map editor' -- confirmed/clarified: the exit marker (S476) is NOCK-editor-preview only, nothing renders in the real SHANKPIT game client (checked directly against the actual lobby/server C code, confirmed no in-game indicator exists). New showLevelExits checkbox next to the 'Level exits' panel, defaults on, a cheap visibility-only THREE.Group.visible flip -- never rebuilds geometry on toggle. Verified the new checkbox text landed in both the built bundle and the deployed Go binary before restarting iduna.service. Commits: f004031, ce3e6f0.

⚓ ☃
title: Editor-only on/off toggle for the level exit 3D marker
